questions.q: The total leucocyte count in uncomplicated typhoid fever typically shows:
questions.why: Typhoid characteristically causes leucopenia with relative lymphocytosis and absent eosinophils; leucocytosis suggests a complication such as perforation.

questions.q: An impulse to jump down when crossing a bridge or standing in a high place calls for:
questions.why: Argentum nitricum: on a high place or bridge, the thought of jumping off; fear of high buildings (Boericke).

questions.q: Chamomilla (Matricaria chamomilla) belongs to which plant family?
questions.why: Chamomilla, like Arnica, belongs to the Compositae; Belladonna is Solanaceae, Aconite Ranunculaceae and Nux vomica Loganiaceae.

questions.q: Under India's UIP, the first dose of measles–rubella (MR) vaccine is given at:
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Second dose at 16–24 months.

questions.q: Which repertory is most suited to a case with few mental symptoms but clear modalities and concomitants?
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. Boenninghausen's generalisation of modalities works when mentals are scanty.

questions.q: Vital statistics include all of the following EXCEPT:
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Vital events are births, deaths, marriages, divorces and so on.

questions.q: According to §16, the vital force can be affected only by:
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. §16: being spirit-like, it can be deranged and restored only by dynamic influences.

questions.q: According to the demographic cycle, India is in (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025):
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Birth rate falling, death rate low.

questions.q: The sixth edition of the Organon was first published, in German, in:
questions.why: Hahnemann finished the manuscript in 1842, a year before his death; Richard Haehl published it in 1921.

questions.q: Angina with a sensation as if the heart were grasped by an iron hand, worse lying on the left side, calls for:
questions.why: Constriction 'as if by an iron band or hand' around the heart and chest is the keynote of Cactus grandiflorus.
